column3: Ayase Route ・ Ayase's Life Counseling 1
And as such, Ayase and my intimate 'first collaboration' continued.
That being the case...
Ah?!
Hey, I've been hearing talking for a while now, did someone come over?
O-Onii-san, didn't you say Kirino wouldn't be around today?!
She wasn't here earlier! When the hell did she get home?
W-What should we do?!
W-What can we do...
Eeh～～
It won't open?
A-Ayase, we need more force to keep the door closed!
I-I know that!
My room doesn't have a lock.
We have to somehow lure Kirino away from the door!
I-I'd rather die than having Kirino see me here!
For starters, Sis×Sis was still running on the PC!
Hey... Why are you holding the door down?!
Y-You didn't... You didn't bring another girl home again while I was away, did you?!
What are you, my wife?!
Gross! What are you saying?! Open up right now!
Onii-san, what did she mean by 'again'?
That doesn't matter right now!
You can't just barge in here whenever you want! There's nobody else here!
Then why are you holding the door down?
There's something you don't want me to see, isn't there?!
You're misunderstanding! Just hurry up and go away!
Then explain to me why you can't open the door!
Damn it, Kirino... Her timing is absolutely awful!
Onii-san, you have to come up with a better excuse!
Even if you say that...
Hey, Kirino... Why do you have to come in here so badly?
It's not like it matters to you who I choose to bring home.
A-Are you stupid? That's the worst excuse ever!
S-Shut up! Just open the door already!
Geh?!
I-I'm in the middle of a really embarrassing scene in this game right now, so don't come in!
I was just improvising, but that was a rather convincing line, right?
In any case, it's not a lie.
I don't know what would've happened if I said I'm actually playing it with Ayase.
Eh... Really?
Really really!
Eh～ You're the very image of a disgusting gamer, shut up in your room playing 18+ games in broad daylight, huh??
So, what are you playing?
Ah, could you be playing Sis×Sis? You finally started playing it? Geez, you're so slow!
So how is it? What do you think about it?
C-Crap, she seems even more determined now!
Whoaaa!
It's over.
Geez, stop making me waste so much energy... Huh?
You're alone?
Eh?
...Ayase vanished?!
Where did she disappear to?
Kirino carefully scanned my room.
W-What...?
I can smell a girl's scent.
Eeh?!
H-Hey... What are you planning to do with my bed?
Nothing. I was just wondering if there might be a girl hiding somewhere near here.
...No one here, huh.
How about here?
...No one.
I'm telling you, there's no one here!
H-Huh? Ayase isn't here?!
Just where had she gone in that one moment?
I peeked under the bed while Kirino was facing away.
Are you some kind of ninja?!
Ayase is actually hiding under my bed!
There's really no one here. Hmm, was I imagining things?
I-I told you, didn't I? There's no one else here.
Hmm. Well, whatever.
Okay, now just get out.
...Ah, you're playing Sis×Sis.
Y-Yeah...
You told me to play it, right? ...So I was just...
Hmm...
I see. You panicked when I suddenly barged in since you were on this kind of scene.
A kissing scene with Rinko was shown on the screen.
Luckily for us, the main character's name wasn't shown.
Huhu, gross.
Y-You played it too, didn't you?
So, what do you think about it?
Why do I have to tell you what I think?
Just tell me.
Well... Rinko is kind of... similar to you.
Eh?
...W-What do you think you're saying?
You're totally gross. Showing me a kissing scene and saying she's similar to me, doesn't that count as sexual harassment??
...Oh, yeah. Sorry.
...By the way, how do you think she's similar to me?
Your cheekiness.
That's all?
And your unreasonableness.
There's also your sharp tongue.
Your face keeps popping up all the time, so it's really difficult to continue.
...Huh?
If I had to say, I'd go with the new heroine, Asahi-chan being the best.
Having gone out of my way to give her my full impression of Sis×Sis, I thought I'd managed to distract her...
You don't understand anything!
Eh?
At this point, Asahi-chan might be the kind of pretty and delicate heroine you like.
But she's actually a yandere.
Seriously?!
The climax of the Asahi route.
It's a scene where you've persuaded your sisters into accepting your relationship with Asahi-chan.
If you make the wrong choice, Asahi-chan will kill you.
Wha--
Instant dead end. It's not recommended for beginners, so it's better to leave it for later.
Besides, you totally don't understand what makes Rinkorin so appealing!
There is no other heroine that is as sexy and still cute as she is!
It doesn't make it easier for me that the heroine is both sexy and cute if she reminds me of you!
Gross! Just don't associate her with me! Now, listen here! I'll tell you all about Rinkorin's cuteness!!
I don't want to hear it.
...What's up with this situation?
Kirino goes on and on about Rinkorin's appeal...
...while the PC is still running an H-game.
And Ayase is still under my bed.
...This is just too much.
*gasp* W-Well? Think you understand what makes Rinkorin so wonderful now?
*sigh* Kirino has finally ended her speech.
I don't get what makes Rinkorin so wonderful at all.
But I've figured out a great way to use this situation to further our plans.
Hey, Kirino, let's change the topic.
Huh?
Say, do you like Ayase?
Huh? Where did that come from?
Just answer. So, if you had to choose between Rinkorin and Ayase, who do you like?
Now listen, I've told you already.
You can't just line them up and compare 2D to 3D.
Besides, why would you mention Ayase out of the blue?
You're not going after Ayase, are you?
Even if I was, that would be impossible. Ayase hates me, you know.
Lately, you've been at home playing Sis×Sis Moushouden pretty much all the time.
Yeah?
Last time when you got too hooked on LoveTouch, didn't you end up quarreling with Ayase?
...Guh.
So how about this time?
...Ayase might've been a bit mad...
B-But I've been reflecting on my actions!
Then that's good.
...ove her, obviously.
What's that?
I'm saying that I love Ayase, obviously.
But they're both important to me... I can't just choose one.
Hmph, don't make me say that again.
See ya! Make sure you finish Sis×Sis!
You know she loves you a lot, right?
I love her a lot too. We're best friends.
...I see.
...S-She finally left.
D-Did Kirino leave?
Yeah, it's okay now.
Hah, that was nervewracking.
You did well, hiding in there as quickly as you did.
I-I was desperate.
She's like some mysterious person you'd hear about in urban legends.
I'll call you Ninja Master Ayase from now on.
Onii-san...
Hm?
...I think I can kind of understand why Kirino likes this game.
Okay.
Also...
Kirino did say that she "loves Ayase, obviously".
I told you, there's no need to worry about anything.
You guys are best friends.
...Yes. Thank you very much... Onii-san.
And as such, Ayase's life counseling session came to an end.
I guess some of Ayase's worries have been solved now that she's reaffirmed her relationship with Kirino.
And they all lived happily ever after, I guess.
